test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

All sedans are vehicles.

All vehicles are machines.

Some machines are noisy.

Conclusions:

I. Some sedans are noisy.

II. All sedans are machines.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/571dc9e163807b92cd672527fcb386669a7033dd64818163c51353381161908c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sedans are noisy → Does not follow (There is no direct relation given between sedan and noisy. so, it is possible not definite).**

II. All sedans are machines → Follow (All sedan are vehicles and all vehicles are machines. so, all sedan are definitely machines).

Only II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 2**”.
